method: Twenty deliberately risk-focused apps spanning all five categories. Not a random or independent human accuracy sample. Each entry checks one material claim, not all fields.

checks.claim_checked: Dedicated MCP setup/FAQ conflicts with the Enterprise-only comparison page. Keep medium confidence and plan ambiguity.
Personal/OAuth credentials differ from organization plan tokens; API and MCP quotas must not be merged.
Service-account file access does not always need domain-wide delegation; public sensitive/restricted scopes are a separate verification issue.
Free Doc Makers have a limited MCP taste; Editors are read-only. Do not equate token creation with full MCP access.
Remote MCP source says read-only CRM standard records, contrary to the draft broad read/write claim. Corrected.
Free plan does not grant API entitlement; trial/paid Standard+ is the practical path. Corrected access bucket.
Vendor-hosted API overview uses older plan names. Paid API gate is preserved with medium confidence; aggregator MCP is not server ownership evidence.
Commerce Advanced is a paid-plan API-key gate, not an administrator approval bucket. Corrected.
Current body says developer tokens sunset9Sep2026; Cloud-project access levels replace them. Summary text can be stale.
Export FAQ gates report Query API while current MCP guide describes some Free-account access. Keep conditional, do not promise full Free query support.
Responsible Builder Policy requires explicit API approval; legacy registration is not enough.
Advertiser authorization is separate from application approval; no business account was connected.
Starter remote MCP is demo-organization-only; real organizations need Core+ except stated exemption.
Sandbox is always free. Production trial applies only to eligible US/Canada teams and limited Items; it is not universal production access.
Current API help states webhooks and Scheduling API on all plans including Free, with enterprise-only endpoints separately listed.
Compass MCP is knowledge/coding oriented, not proof of billing transactions.
New signups closed4Jun2025; existing access ends5Apr2027. Block new toolkit onboarding despite extant API docs.
Hosted MCP explicitly excludes Free plans even though ordinary account/API development has a free route.
REST api-scoped legacy tokens do not imply MCP mcp-scope acceptance.
Admin API manages clusters/users, not stored database documents. Direct API IP-list rules and delegated client rules differ.
